* Simplifying `JNLPLauncher` (#8762) @jglick

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-60866](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-60866) - [JENKINS-71051](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71051) - [JENKINS-71048](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71048) - Un-inline 'Build Now' JS (#7635) @daniel-beck

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* Add telemetry for Jenkins uptime (#8596) @daniel-beck
* [JENKINS-72156](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72156) - Upgrade to Winstone 6.14 which contains an upgrade to Jetty 10.0.17 (#8587) @olamy

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-72170](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72170) - fix nested hetero-list entries with mixture of inputs and buttons (#8602) @mawinter69
* [JENKINS-72020](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72020) - Restore ability to reorder clouds (#8492) @Vlatombe

## 🌐 Localization and translation

* [JENKINS-72148](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72148) - Add missing fr properties in hudson directory (#8586) @jgreffe
* [JENKINS-72148](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72148) - Add missing fr properties for win32errors (#8594) @jgreffe
* [JENKINS-72148](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72148) - Add missing fr properties in package jenkins (#8595) @jgreffe
* [JENKINS-72143](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72143) - French translation (#8578) @jgreffe
* [JENKINS-72141](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72141) - French translation (#8577) @jgreffe

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* [JENKINS-72107](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72107) - Introduce `Loadable` interface (#8544) @Vlatombe
* [JENKINS-72111](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72111) - Allow `Lifecycle` to load implementations from plugins (#8589) @jglick
* [JENKINS-72156](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72156) - Upgrade to Winstone 6.14 which contains an upgrade to Jetty 10.0.17 (#8587) @olamy

## 📦 Dependency updates

* Bump org.jacoco:jacoco-maven-plugin from 0.8.10 to 0.8.11 (#8615) @dependabot
* Bump org.jenkins-ci.main:remoting from 3160.vd76b_9ddd10cc to 3174.v2c9e67f8f9df (#8614) @dependabot

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JENKINS-71866](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71866) - Allow to use alternate values for "Build with Parameters" and the "Build" button on the parameters page (#8496) @mawinter69
* Optimization for `AbstractLazyLoadRunMap.loadNumberOnDisk` (#8494) @jglick
* Increase minimum required Remoting version from 4.7 to 4.13 (#8484) @basil

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-71890](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71890) - Model links in build history views and administrative monitors no longer work (#8485) @benebsiny
* [JENKINS-72018](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72018) - Form entries in .repeated-chunk using .show-if-not-only CSS class are not hidden when they are alone (#8491) @flabrie
* fix signup autofocus (#8474) @jtnord
* [JENKINS-71880](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71880) - fix notification in breadcrumb (#8493) @mawinter69
* [JENKINS-72016](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72016) - Define a thread pool for `ProxyConfiguration`’s `HttpClient` (#8490) @jglick

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* LogRecorder programmatic deletion support (#8489) @Vlatombe

* Bump stapler.version from 1802.1804.va_8d30483a_7f7 to 1814.vdc9dd5217ee2 (#8522) @dependabot

## 🚨 Removed

* Remove WebSocket support for Jetty 9 (#7101) @jglick
* [JENKINS-70927](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70927) - Remove unused projectViewNested (#7906) @timja

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JENKINS-70805](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70805) - Remove `!important` from styles in `<pre>` (#7836) @uhafner
* [JENKINS-70729](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70729) - Rework clouds management into multiple pages (#7658) @Vlatombe

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-71115](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71115) - Builds filter field doesn't use full width on sub 970px windows (#7870) @niralmaruda
* [JENKINS-71160](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71160) - Fix "Tmp directories are hidden" alert icon (#7891) @flabrie
* [JENKINS-71152](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71152) - The System page breadcrumb no longer displays a list of page sections (#7887) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-70115](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70115) - The full width side panel's right side is too close to the border (#7420) @davidho0403

* Simplifying `JNLPLauncher` (#8762) @jglick

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-60866](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-60866) - [JENKINS-71051](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71051) - [JENKINS-71048](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71048) - Un-inline 'Build Now' JS (#7635) @daniel-beck

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* Add telemetry for Jenkins uptime (#8596) @daniel-beck
* [JENKINS-72156](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72156) - Upgrade to Winstone 6.14 which contains an upgrade to Jetty 10.0.17 (#8587) @olamy

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-72170](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72170) - fix nested hetero-list entries with mixture of inputs and buttons (#8602) @mawinter69
* [JENKINS-72020](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72020) - Restore ability to reorder clouds (#8492) @Vlatombe

## 🌐 Localization and translation

* [JENKINS-72148](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72148) - Add missing fr properties in hudson directory (#8586) @jgreffe
* [JENKINS-72148](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72148) - Add missing fr properties for win32errors (#8594) @jgreffe
* [JENKINS-72148](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72148) - Add missing fr properties in package jenkins (#8595) @jgreffe
* [JENKINS-72143](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72143) - French translation (#8578) @jgreffe
* [JENKINS-72141](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72141) - French translation (#8577) @jgreffe

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* [JENKINS-72107](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72107) - Introduce `Loadable` interface (#8544) @Vlatombe
* [JENKINS-72111](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72111) - Allow `Lifecycle` to load implementations from plugins (#8589) @jglick
* [JENKINS-72156](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72156) - Upgrade to Winstone 6.14 which contains an upgrade to Jetty 10.0.17 (#8587) @olamy

## 📦 Dependency updates

* Bump org.jacoco:jacoco-maven-plugin from 0.8.10 to 0.8.11 (#8615) @dependabot
* Bump org.jenkins-ci.main:remoting from 3160.vd76b_9ddd10cc to 3174.v2c9e67f8f9df (#8614) @dependabot

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JENKINS-71866](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71866) - Allow to use alternate values for "Build with Parameters" and the "Build" button on the parameters page (#8496) @mawinter69
* Optimization for `AbstractLazyLoadRunMap.loadNumberOnDisk` (#8494) @jglick
* Increase minimum required Remoting version from 4.7 to 4.13 (#8484) @basil

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-71890](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71890) - Model links in build history views and administrative monitors no longer work (#8485) @benebsiny
* [JENKINS-72018](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72018) - Form entries in .repeated-chunk using .show-if-not-only CSS class are not hidden when they are alone (#8491) @flabrie
* fix signup autofocus (#8474) @jtnord
* [JENKINS-71880](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71880) - fix notification in breadcrumb (#8493) @mawinter69
* [JENKINS-72016](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-72016) - Define a thread pool for `ProxyConfiguration`’s `HttpClient` (#8490) @jglick

## 👷 Changes for plugin developers

* LogRecorder programmatic deletion support (#8489) @Vlatombe

* Bump stapler.version from 1802.1804.va_8d30483a_7f7 to 1814.vdc9dd5217ee2 (#8522) @dependabot

## 🚨 Removed

* Remove WebSocket support for Jetty 9 (#7101) @jglick
* [JENKINS-70927](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70927) - Remove unused projectViewNested (#7906) @timja

## 🚀 New features and improvements

* [JENKINS-70805](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70805) - Remove `!important` from styles in `<pre>` (#7836) @uhafner
* [JENKINS-70729](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70729) - Rework clouds management into multiple pages (#7658) @Vlatombe

## 🐛 Bug fixes

* [JENKINS-71115](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71115) - Builds filter field doesn't use full width on sub 970px windows (#7870) @niralmaruda
* [JENKINS-71160](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71160) - Fix "Tmp directories are hidden" alert icon (#7891) @flabrie
* [JENKINS-71152](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-71152) - The System page breadcrumb no longer displays a list of page sections (#7887) @janfaracik
* [JENKINS-70115](https://issues.jenkins.io/browse/JENKINS-70115) - The full width side panel's right side is too close to the border (#7420) @davidho0403
